sub-flow.name: sf-charge-order
sub-flow.doc:description: Simulated charge of the order in the payload: records one ledger entry per charge; called by both charge endpoints after the idempotent validator.

os:store.doc:name: Record Charge
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, chargeId: vars.vChargeId, amount: payload.amount, chargedAt: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log charge
logger.message: #['Charged orderId=' ++ payload.orderId ++ ', chargeId=' ++ vars.vChargeId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

sub-flow.name: sf-record-duplicate-charge
sub-flow.doc:description: Records in the ledger a charge request the idempotent validator rejected as a duplicate; called from the charge endpoints' error handler.

os:store.doc:name: Record Rejected Duplicate
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, correlationId: correlationId, rejectedAt: now() as String }]

sub-flow.name: sf-summarise-payment-ledger
sub-flow.doc:description: Counts the charges and rejected duplicates recorded for the order in vars.vLedgerOrderId; called by GET /eip/payments/{orderId}/charges and the MUnit suite.

flow.name: payment-get-ledger
flow.doc:description: GET /eip/payments/{orderId}/charges: how many times an order was charged and how many duplicates were rejected.

sub-flow.name: sf-validate-charge-request
sub-flow.doc:description: Validates the body of a charge request: orderId and a numeric amount are required.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or not (payload.amount is Number)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing charge fields

flow.name: payment-charge-batch-client
flow.doc:description: Batch client: POST /eip/payments/{version}/charges/batch posts each charge of the array to the before or after charge endpoint over HTTP, inside a For Each, and collects the results.

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Empty batch
raise-error.description: The body must be a non-empty array of charges

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log batch start
logger.message: #['Charge batch (' ++ vars.vVersion ++ ') of ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { version: vars.vVersion, results: vars.vResults }
